cases.head: e1f8318b5e403c5ae9807adcf151bef301112f6a
cases.title: Update pickup status when creating trips
cases.description: When a trip is created, update its selected pickup requests and embedded pickups to STARTED. Only select PLANNED requests.

expected.description: Trip creation does not await the pickup status writes and can report success while requests are still PLANNED.
expected.evidence: createTrip launches async callbacks via forEach, then saves the trip and responds without awaiting their promises. Deferred updateOne promises demonstrate the response precedes completion. The outer catch also cannot catch those callback rejections. Treat these consequences as one root cause.

cases.notes: Other valid new issues, including partial failure consistency, may be found. Adjudicate them rather than rejecting findings absent from expected.
cases.human_review: User uncertain; do not treat the expected finding as human-confirmed.

cases.head: 3b51f60dc0a48fbadc6d23d5d9ed95a1916b1294
cases.title: Filter completed pickups from resident trip responses
cases.description: The resident trip response should include only unfinished pickups up to and including the requested resident. Update the existing integration test to cover a completed earlier pickup.
cases.notes: Provisional control: no new defect identified in the filter and accompanying test update. The pre-existing array query behavior is not introduced here. A finding outside this known set is unjudged, not automatically wrong; this is not a claim that the repository is bug-free.
cases.human_review: User saw no issue and requested another diff.
